headline: The Pain Management Master 20
threshold: By Lesson 20, you can train new pain-clinic staff and have them teach back in Spanish, explain a postponed or changed procedure to a frustrated patient, refuse an unsafe request with care, debrief an incident or near miss without blame, and dictate the day's report.

lessons.title: Orienting a New Medical Assistant to Clinic Flow
lessons.objective: Walk a new medical assistant through the pain clinic's visit flow and explain the reason for each step.

words.note: For a woman; for a man say el asistente médico.
Common in US clinics; you will also hear la sala de exploración.

words.en: First, the patient checks in at the front desk.
words.es: Primero, el paciente se registra en la recepción.

words.en: Then you ask them their pain level from 0 to 10.
words.es: Después le preguntas su nivel de dolor del 0 al 10.
words.note: Informal (tú) to a coworker.

words.en: We ask for the sample first because the result takes a few minutes.
words.es: Pedimos la muestra antes porque el resultado tarda unos minutos.

words.en: That's why the doctor already has the result when he walks in.
words.es: Por eso el doctor ya tiene el resultado cuando entra.

words.en: First I'll weigh you, ma'am, and then we'll go to room 3.
words.es: Primero la peso, señora, y luego pasamos al cuarto 3.
words.note: Formal (usted) to a patient.

words.en: Sir, did you bring your medication list?
words.note: Formal (usted) to a patient.

words.en: If you don't understand something, feel free to ask me.
words.es: Si no entiendes algo, pregúntame sin pena.
words.note: Informal; sin pena is common Mexican Spanish for 'don't be shy'.
Informal (tú) to a coworker.

lessons.speaking: You are the clinic lead, and the AI is Lucía Ferrer, a new medical assistant: walk her through the visit from check-in to pain scores to the exam room and explain why each step happens, using primero, luego, porque and por eso.

grammar.focus: Connectors for sequence and cause (primero, luego, porque, por eso)

examples.es: Primero el paciente llena el cuestionario y luego pasa a signos vitales.
examples.en: First the patient fills out the questionnaire and then goes to vital signs.

examples.es: El doctor necesita el resultado, por eso la muestra va primero.
examples.en: The doctor needs the result, that's why the sample comes first.

lessons.title: Why We Repeat the Safety Questions Every Time
lessons.objective: Explain to a new pre-procedure nurse why the screening questions are asked again before each injection.

words.note: Patients often say medicina para adelgazar la sangre.
Área is feminine but takes el in the singular: el área, las áreas.
For a woman: la cardióloga.

words.en: We ask every time because things change.
words.es: Se pregunta cada vez porque las cosas cambian.
words.note: Impersonal se: no specific person does the action.

words.en: The chart may be out of date.
If they have a fever, the doctor is notified before starting.
words.es: Si tiene fiebre, se avisa al médico antes de empezar.

words.en: If you're unsure, ask the charge nurse.
words.es: Si tienes duda, pregúntale a la enfermera encargada.
words.note: Informal (tú) to a coworker.

words.en: Do you take any blood thinner?
words.es: ¿Toma usted algún medicamento para adelgazar la sangre?
words.note: Formal (usted) to a patient.

words.en: When did you take the last pill?
words.note: Formal (usted) to a patient.

words.en: Have you ever had a reaction to contrast dye?
words.es: ¿Alguna vez tuvo una reacción al medio de contraste?
words.note: Formal (usted) to a patient.

lessons.speaking: You are the lead pain physician, and the AI is Andrés Pineda, a new pre-procedure nurse: explain why the blood thinner, contrast allergy and infection questions are asked before every injection, using impersonal se and si + present (si toma anticoagulante, se avisa al médico).

grammar.focus: Impersonal se; si + present for general truths (si el paciente toma anticoagulante, se avisa al médico)

examples.es: Si el paciente toma un anticoagulante, se confirma la fecha de la última dosis.
examples.en: If the patient takes a blood thinner, the date of the last dose is confirmed.

examples.es: Las preguntas se repiten antes de cada inyección.
examples.en: The questions are repeated before each injection.

lessons.title: Setting Up the Fluoroscopy Suite With a Trainee
lessons.objective: Give clear step-by-step instructions to set up a sterile tray and the suite, then have the trainee repeat them.

words.note: Many staff just say el arco.
Mexico says caducidad; other countries say fecha de vencimiento.

words.en: Open it outward, away from your body.
words.es: Ábrelo hacia afuera, lejos de tu cuerpo.
words.note: Informal (tú) to a trainee; the pronoun attaches to the command.

words.en: Don't touch it without sterile gloves.
words.es: No lo toques sin guantes estériles.
words.note: Negative command: the pronoun goes before the verb.

words.en: Read it to me out loud: medication, strength and date.
words.es: Léemelo en voz alta: medicamento, concentración y fecha.

words.en: Label it before you put it on the field.
words.es: Etiquétala antes de ponerla en el campo.

words.en: If you're not sure it's sterile, replace it.
words.es: Si tienes duda de que esté estéril, cámbialo.

words.en: Now repeat it back to me, step by step.
Sir, please don't touch the blue drape.
words.es: Señor, no toque la sábana azul, por favor.
words.note: Formal (usted) to a patient.

lessons.speaking: You are the procedure lead, and the AI is Yesenia Ocampo, a procedure nurse trainee: talk her through setting up the sterile tray and the fluoroscopy suite with commands like ábrelo, no lo toques and léemelo, then have her repeat the steps back.

grammar.focus: Commands with object pronouns (ábrelo, no lo toques, léemelo)

examples.es: Ábrelo por las orillas y no lo toques por dentro.
examples.en: Open it by the edges and don't touch the inside.

examples.es: La etiqueta del frasco: léemela antes de llenar la jeringa.
examples.en: The vial label: read it to me before you fill the syringe.

lessons.title: Reading a Stimulator MRI Card With a Patient
lessons.objective: Read the manufacturer's MRI card with a patient and explain the steps that must happen before any scan.

words.note: Staff often just say el representante or el rep.
For a woman: la técnica de resonancia.
Means the scan is allowed only under the exact conditions the manufacturer lists.
Patients say cables; clinicians also say electrodos.

words.en: May I see your implant card?
words.es: ¿Me permite ver la tarjeta de su implante?
words.note: Formal (usted) to a patient.

words.en: The card says the conditions depend on the exact model.
words.es: La tarjeta dice que las condiciones dependen del modelo exacto.

words.en: Before you have the MRI, we need to confirm your model.
words.es: Antes de hacerse la resonancia, hay que confirmar su modelo.

words.en: We have to call the rep before scheduling the appointment.
words.es: Hay que llamar al representante antes de programar la cita.

words.en: The rep will tell you if the MRI mode needs to be turned on.
words.es: El representante le dirá si hay que activar el modo resonancia.

words.en: If you feel heat or anything strange, tell the technologist right away.
words.es: Si siente calor o algo raro, avísele al técnico enseguida.
words.note: Formal (usted) command.

words.en: After the MRI is done, we need to check the stimulator.
words.es: Después de terminar la resonancia, hay que revisar el estimulador.

words.en: Don't schedule anything until I confirm with you.
words.es: No programe nada hasta que yo le confirme.
words.note: Formal (usted) to a patient.

lessons.speaking: You are the pain physician, and the AI is Tomás Echeverría, a patient with an implanted stimulator who needs a knee MRI: read his MRI card with him and explain the steps before the scan, using antes de / después de + infinitive and hay que.

grammar.focus: Antes de / después de + infinitive; hay que (antes de hacerse la resonancia, hay que llamar al representante)

examples.es: Antes de programar la cita, hay que llamar al representante del fabricante.
examples.en: Before scheduling the appointment, we have to call the manufacturer's rep.

examples.es: Después de hablar con radiología, le llamo para confirmar.
examples.en: After talking with radiology, I'll call you to confirm.

lessons.title: Infected Skin Found at the Injection Site
lessons.objective: Ask what happened to the skin, explain why the injection is postponed, and propose a new plan to an upset patient.

words.note: Adjective expression; agrees with the noun: la piel está caliente al tacto.
Whether to treat is the treating doctor's decision; you inform and refer.
Preterite for the moment something started.

words.en: Did you have a fever or chills this week?
words.note: Imperfect for an ongoing state in the past. Formal usted.

words.en: Did it hurt or itch before today?
words.es: ¿Le dolía o le picaba antes de hoy?

words.en: Today we can't inject through this skin.
words.es: Hoy no podemos inyectar a través de esta piel.

words.en: The needle could carry bacteria toward the spine.
words.es: La aguja podría llevar bacterias hacia la columna.

words.en: I know you drove two hours to come, and I'm very sorry.
words.es: Sé que manejó dos horas para venir, y lo siento mucho.

words.en: I would propose another date, once the skin is healthy.
words.es: Le propondría otra fecha, cuando la piel ya esté sana.
words.note: Conditional softens the proposal; cuando + subjunctive for a future time.

words.en: Ramiro, did you take a photo of the lesion?
words.es: Ramiro, ¿le tomaste foto a la lesión?
words.note: Informal tú with a coworker.

lessons.speaking: You are the pain physician, and the AI is Gloria Benavides, an upset patient: ask about the red patch with the preterite and imperfect (¿cuándo apareció?, ¿tenía fiebre?), explain why the injection is postponed, and propose a new plan with the conditional (le propondría).

grammar.focus: Preterite vs imperfect; conditional for the proposal (¿cuándo apareció?, ¿tenía fiebre?, le propondría otra fecha)

examples.es: La semana pasada era una picadura, pero ayer empezó a doler más.
examples.en: Last week it was a bite, but yesterday it started to hurt more.

examples.es: Yo le recomendaría ver a su médico de cabecera hoy mismo.
examples.en: I would recommend that you see your primary care doctor today.

lessons.title: Backordered Steroid: Explaining the Substitute
lessons.objective: Explain a pharmacy substitution, compare waiting with going ahead, and answer the patient's doubts.

words.note: Common in Mexico for a supply shortage.
Adjective; agrees with the noun: el esteroide está agotado.

words.en: Pharmacy told us the usual steroid is out of stock.
words.es: La farmacia nos avisó que el esteroide de siempre está agotado.

words.en: We're going to use the substitute Dr. Medina approved with pharmacy.
words.es: Vamos a usar el sustituto que aprobó el Dr. Medina con farmacia.
words.note: Ir a + infinitive for a near, planned action.

words.en: According to pharmacy, there's no firm date for the order.
words.es: Según la farmacia, no hay fecha segura para el pedido.

words.en: What you read online doesn't always apply to your case.
words.es: Lo que leyó en internet no siempre aplica a su caso.

words.en: What worries you more, the effect or the wait?
words.es: ¿Qué le preocupa más, el efecto o la espera?

words.en: If you prefer to wait, we'll call you when it arrives.
words.es: Si prefiere esperar, lo llamaremos cuando llegue.
words.note: Simple future for a promise; cuando + subjunctive.

words.en: Inés, can you confirm in writing which medication you'll send?
words.es: Inés, ¿me confirma por escrito qué medicamento va a mandar?
words.note: Formal usted with a colleague.

words.en: It's your decision; you don't have to answer right now.
words.es: Usted decide; no tiene que contestar ahora mismo.

lessons.speaking: You are the pain physician, and the AI is Ernesto Villalba, a patient who thinks the substitute is weaker: explain the pharmacy substitution with the future and ir a (vamos a usar, llegará), compare waiting with going ahead (más largo que, tan… como), and answer his doubts.

grammar.focus: Future and ir a; comparisons (vamos a usar, la espera será más larga que)

examples.es: Vamos a usar dexametasona, que el Dr. Medina aprobó con farmacia.
examples.en: We're going to use dexamethasone, which Dr. Medina approved with pharmacy.

examples.es: Según la farmacia, la espera será más larga de lo que pensábamos.
examples.en: According to pharmacy, the wait will be longer than we thought.

lessons.title: A Workers' Comp Case Manager Joins the Visit
lessons.objective: Give injury and treatment dates and numbers clearly while protecting what the patient has not authorized you to share.

words.note: Feminine for a woman; el administrador de casos for a man.

words.en: Ms. Quiroga, I ask you to wait outside during the exam.
words.es: Señora Quiroga, le pido que espere afuera durante el examen.
words.note: Formal usted; polite but firm.

words.en: Without a signed release, I can't discuss his exam.
words.es: Sin autorización firmada, no puedo hablar de su examen.

words.en: Mr. Salinas, do you want her to hear this part?
words.es: Señor Salinas, ¿quiere que ella escuche esta parte?

words.en: He got hurt on March 3 at the warehouse.
words.es: Se lastimó el 3 de marzo en el almacén.
words.note: Preterite for a completed event on a specific date.

words.en: He received 2 injections, one in April and one in June.
words.es: Recibió 2 inyecciones, una en abril y otra en junio.

words.en: Let me repeat the date: March 3, not the 13th.
words.es: Le repito la fecha: el 3 de marzo, no el 13.
words.note: Say tres and trece slowly; they sound alike under pressure.

words.en: I can't give you a return-to-work date yet.
words.es: Todavía no puedo darle una fecha de regreso al trabajo.

words.en: We'll send you the report in writing once he authorizes it.
words.es: Le mandaremos el informe por escrito cuando él lo autorice.

lessons.speaking: You are the pain physician, and the AI is Marisol Quiroga, a workers' comp case manager at Héctor's follow-up: give injury and treatment dates clearly in the preterite (se lastimó el 3 de marzo, recibió 2 inyecciones) and protect what Héctor has not authorized you to share.

grammar.focus: Preterite narration; numbers under pressure (se lastimó el 3 de marzo, recibió dos inyecciones)

examples.es: El señor Salinas se lastimó el 3 de marzo y empezó fisioterapia el 20 de marzo.
examples.en: Mr. Salinas got hurt on March 3 and started physical therapy on March 20.

examples.es: Recibió 2 inyecciones epidurales; la última fue el 12 de junio.
examples.en: He received 2 epidural injections; the last one was on June 12.

lessons.title: Patient Wants to Drive Home After Sedation
lessons.objective: Refuse a patient's request to drive after sedation, explain why, and help him find a safe way home.

words.note: Feminine for a woman: la acompañante.
Common US/Mexican loanword; also la camioneta.
Feminine noun that takes el in the singular: el alta, las altas.

words.en: Mr. Castaño, please don't drive today.
words.es: Señor Castaño, no maneje hoy, por favor.
words.note: Negative formal command: no + usted subjunctive form.

words.en: I don't recommend that you leave alone after sedation.
words.es: No recomiendo que se vaya solo después de la sedación.
words.note: No recomiendo que triggers the subjunctive.

words.en: Even if you feel fine, your reflexes are still slow.
words.es: Aunque se sienta bien, sus reflejos todavía están lentos.

words.en: According to the center's policy, you need a responsible adult.
words.es: Según la política del centro, necesita un adulto responsable.

words.en: Who else can we call to come get you?
words.es: ¿A quién más podemos llamar para que venga por usted?

words.en: Don't worry about your truck; we'll figure out where to leave it today.
words.es: No se preocupe por su troca; vemos dónde dejarla hoy.

words.en: Don't sign anything important today either.
words.es: No firme nada importante hoy tampoco.

words.en: Don't let him leave until his escort arrives.
words.es: No lo dejes salir hasta que llegue su acompañante.
words.note: Informal tú with a coworker.

lessons.speaking: You are the CRNA, and the AI is Rubén Castaño, a patient in recovery after sedation who wants to drive his own truck home: refuse with negative commands (no maneje hoy) and no recomiendo que + subjunctive, explain why, and help him find a safe way home.

grammar.focus: Negative commands; subjunctive after no recomiendo que (no maneje hoy, no recomiendo que se vaya solo)

examples.es: No maneje ni use máquinas hasta mañana, según sus instrucciones de alta.
examples.en: Don't drive or use machinery until tomorrow, according to your discharge instructions.

examples.es: No recomiendo que tome un taxi solo; necesita que alguien lo acompañe.
examples.en: I don't recommend that you take a taxi alone; you need someone to go with you.

lessons.title: Feedback for a Fellow Who Rushed a Consent
lessons.objective: Give a fellow specific, respectful feedback on a rushed consent and agree on what she will do differently.

words.note: Use el doctor en formación for a man.
Área is feminine but takes el because it starts with a stressed a.

words.en: Camila, do you have a few minutes to talk about the consult?
words.es: Camila, ¿tienes unos minutos para hablar de la consulta?
words.note: Informal: tú between attending and fellow.

words.en: Mrs. Lugo said she didn't understand the risks.
words.es: La señora Lugo dijo que no entendió los riesgos.

words.en: I want you to ask her what she understood, in her own words.
words.es: Quiero que le preguntes qué entendió, con sus propias palabras.

words.en: I recommend you go over the explanation again more calmly.
words.es: Te recomiendo que repitas la explicación con más calma.

words.en: It's important that you don't rush her before she signs.
words.es: Es importante que no la apures antes de firmar.

words.en: I suggest you talk with her again before the procedure.
words.es: Sugiero que vuelvas a hablar con ella antes del procedimiento.

words.en: What do you think happened with the time in that consult?
words.es: ¿Qué crees que pasó con el tiempo en esa consulta?

words.en: Mrs. Lugo, I want you to understand clearly before you decide.
words.es: Señora Lugo, quiero que entienda bien antes de decidir.
words.note: Formal: usted with the patient.

lessons.speaking: You are the attending physician, and the AI is Dr. Camila Restrepo, a fellow who rushed a nerve block consent: give specific, respectful feedback and agree on what she will do differently, using quiero que and te recomiendo que with the present subjunctive.

grammar.focus: Present subjunctive after wishes and recommendations (quiero que le preguntes, te recomiendo que repitas)

examples.es: Quiero que le preguntes a la señora Lugo qué entendió.
examples.en: I want you to ask Mrs. Lugo what she understood.

examples.es: Te recomiendo que uses lenguaje sencillo, sin jerga médica.
examples.en: I recommend you use plain language, without medical jargon.

lessons.title: Settling a Scheduling Clash Between Two Colleagues
lessons.objective: Hear each side, report back what each person said, and settle a conflict over a double-booked procedure slot.

words.note: Use la encargada de citas for a woman.

words.en: each person's side of the story
Nelson, tell me your side without interruptions.
words.es: Nelson, cuéntame tu versión sin interrupciones.
words.note: Informal: tú with a coworker.

words.en: Nelson says you confirmed the room to him by phone.
words.es: Nelson dice que tú le confirmaste la sala por teléfono.

words.en: Pilar, according to Nelson, the schedule showed the slot as open.
words.es: Pilar, según Nelson, la agenda mostraba el espacio libre.

words.en: So both of you thought the other one had confirmed it.
words.es: Entonces, los dos pensaban que el otro lo había confirmado.

words.en: We're not here to find someone to blame.
words.es: No estamos aquí para buscar culpables.

words.en: From now on, confirm the room in writing.
words.es: De ahora en adelante, confirmen la sala por escrito.
words.note: Ustedes command to both colleagues.

words.en: Mr. Ortega, I apologize for the 90-minute wait.
words.es: Señor Ortega, le pido disculpas por la espera de 90 minutos.
words.note: Formal: usted with the patient.

lessons.speaking: You are the physician lead, and the AI plays scheduler Nelson and nurse Pilar: hear each side, report back what each said with reported speech and the imperfect (ella dijo que la sala estaba libre), and settle on a fix together.

grammar.focus: Reported speech; imperfect for background (ella dijo que la sala estaba libre)

examples.es: Pilar dijo que la sala estaba libre a las 10.
examples.en: Pilar said the room was free at 10.

examples.es: Nelson explicó que el sistema no mostraba la otra cita.
examples.en: Nelson explained that the system wasn't showing the other appointment.

lessons.title: Huddle on a Short-Staffed Procedure Day
lessons.objective: Lead a morning huddle, commit to your part of a heavy day, and have each team member teach back their role.

words.note: Agrees: cansada for a woman, cansados for a group.

words.en: We're short a nurse today, but we're going to pull it off.
words.es: Hoy nos falta una enfermera, pero lo vamos a sacar adelante.

words.en: I'll cover recovery between my cases.
words.es: Yo cubriré la recuperación entre mis casos.

words.en: Julio, what will you do after the first case?
words.es: Julio, ¿qué harás tú después del primer caso?
words.note: Informal: tú with a teammate.

words.en: Daniela, tell me your part back, please.
words.es: Daniela, repíteme tu parte, por favor.

words.en: Omar, you'll have the room ready before each case.
words.es: Omar, tendrás la sala lista antes de cada caso.

words.en: If anyone falls behind, let me know right away.
words.es: Si alguien se atrasa, avísenme enseguida.
words.note: Ustedes command to the whole team.

words.en: I know you're tired; I appreciate the effort.
words.es: Sé que están cansados; les agradezco el esfuerzo.
Nadie se saltará la hora de comida hoy.

lessons.speaking: You are the physician leading the morning huddle, and the AI plays Julio, Daniela and Omar: assign roles, commit to your part with the future (yo cubriré la recuperación), encourage them with lo vamos a sacar adelante, and have each teach back their role.

grammar.focus: Future for commitments; encouragement register (yo cubriré la recuperación, lo vamos a sacar adelante)

examples.es: Yo hablaré con los pacientes si hay retraso.
examples.en: I'll talk with the patients if there's a delay.

examples.es: Terminaremos a tiempo si trabajamos juntos.
examples.en: We'll finish on time if we work together.

lessons.title: One Insurance Denial, Four Different Listeners
lessons.objective: Deliver the same insurance denial news to a patient, her son, a coworker and a device rep in the right register.

words.note: A call between your doctor and the insurer's doctor.

words.en: Mrs. Arango, I'd like to talk with you about your insurance.
words.es: Señora Arango, quisiera hablar con usted sobre su seguro.
words.note: Formal: usted with the patient.

words.en: I'm sorry to tell you the insurance denied the stimulator trial.
words.es: Lamento decirle que el seguro negó la prueba del estimulador.

words.en: This doesn't mean we doubt your pain.
words.es: Esto no significa que dudemos de su dolor.

words.en: Would it be all right with you if we file an appeal this week?
words.es: ¿Le parecería bien que presentemos una apelación esta semana?
words.note: Formal softener; it takes the subjunctive after que.

words.en: Kevin, would you be willing to come to the next visit with your mom?
words.es: Kevin, ¿le parecería bien venir a la próxima cita con su mamá?
words.note: Formal: usted with an adult family member.

words.en: Brenda, can you help me gather the notes for the appeal?
words.es: Brenda, ¿me ayudas a juntar las notas para la apelación?
words.note: Informal: tú with a coworker.

words.en: Mauricio, I'd like to ask you to postpone the trial date.
words.es: Mauricio, quisiera pedirle que posponga la fecha de la prueba.
words.note: Formal: usted with an outside rep.

lessons.speaking: You are the clinic physician, and the AI plays patient Lourdes, her son Kevin, MA Brenda and device rep Mauricio: give each one the stimulator trial denial, switching between usted and tú and softening with quisiera and ¿le parecería?

grammar.focus: Usted / tú switching; softeners (quisiera, ¿le parecería?)

examples.es: Señora Arango, quisiera explicarle lo que dice la carta.
examples.en: Mrs. Arango, I'd like to explain to you what the letter says.

examples.es: Brenda, ¿me pasas la carta de rechazo, por favor?
examples.en: Brenda, can you hand me the denial letter, please?

lessons.title: Patient Faints in Recovery: The Incident Report
lessons.objective: Tell a risk manager exactly what happened, in order, and complete the written incident report.

words.note: Verb: desmayarse (se desmayó, she fainted).
La gerente for a woman, el gerente for a man.
El testigo for a man, la testigo for a woman.
For a small cut, many in Mexico and the US also say la cortada.

words.en: Sonia, I'll tell you everything in the exact order.
words.es: Sonia, le cuento todo en el orden exacto.
words.note: Formal: usted with the risk manager.

words.en: At 10:15, the patient got up from the stretcher.
words.es: A las 10:15, la paciente se levantó de la camilla.

words.en: A few minutes later, she said she felt dizzy.
words.es: Unos minutos después, dijo que se sentía mareada.

words.en: As soon as she stood up, she lost consciousness and fell.
words.es: En cuanto se paró, perdió el conocimiento y se cayó.
words.note: Pararse means to stand up in Mexico and the US.

words.en: She hit her head on the stretcher rail.
words.es: Se golpeó la cabeza contra el barandal de la camilla.

words.en: Fabián, correct me if I get any time wrong.
words.es: Fabián, corrígeme si me equivoco en alguna hora.
words.note: Informal: tú between coworkers.

words.en: Mrs. Quintana, don't get up; stay lying down, please.
words.es: Señora Quintana, no se levante; quédese acostada, por favor.
words.note: Formal: usted with the patient.

words.en: In the report I only write what I saw.
words.es: En el informe solo escribo lo que vi.

lessons.speaking: You are the physician at Northside Pain Center, and the AI is risk manager Sonia Peralta: tell her minute by minute how Marta Quintana fainted and cut her scalp, using time markers like a las 10:15, unos minutos después and en cuanto, then confirm the report.

grammar.focus: Past narration with time markers (a las diez y cuarto, unos minutos después, en cuanto)

examples.es: A las 10:00 terminé la inyección y la pasamos a recuperación.
examples.en: At 10:00 I finished the injection and we moved her to recovery.

examples.es: En cuanto la vi en el piso, llamé a Fabián.
examples.en: As soon as I saw her on the floor, I called Fabián.

lessons.title: Wrong-Side Near Miss Caught at the Time-Out
lessons.objective: Lead a no-blame debrief of a side mix-up caught at the time-out and agree on one change to prevent it.

words.note: Many US teams also just say el time-out.
Report term; in conversation people often say casi error.
Captura means data entry in Mexico and the US.

words.en: If we hadn't paused, it could have been the wrong side.
words.es: Si no hubiéramos pausado, podría haber sido el lado equivocado.

words.en: We almost marked the right side.
words.es: Por poco marcamos el lado derecho.
words.note: Por poco takes the present tense but means almost, in the past.

words.en: Alejandra, thank you for speaking up in time; you did the right thing.
words.es: Alejandra, gracias por hablar a tiempo; hiciste lo correcto.
words.note: Informal: tú between coworkers.

words.en: Iván, this isn't your fault; we're going to review the process.
words.es: Iván, esto no es tu culpa; vamos a revisar el proceso.
words.note: Informal: tú between coworkers.

words.en: It almost happened, but the time-out worked.
words.es: Casi pasa, pero la pausa funcionó.

words.en: At what point could it have been caught earlier?
words.es: ¿En qué punto se pudo haber detectado antes?

words.en: I propose that two people verify the side before scheduling.
words.es: Propongo que dos personas verifiquen el lado antes de programar.

words.en: Mr. Robles, which side hurts, please?
words.es: Señor Robles, ¿de qué lado le duele, por favor?
words.note: Formal: usted with the patient.

lessons.speaking: You are the physician leading the debrief in procedure room 4, and the AI is radiology tech Iván Corral: go over the left-right mix-up without blame using si no hubiéramos pausado, podría haber sido and por poco, and agree on one process change.

grammar.focus: Casi, por poco, podría haber; si clauses (si no hubiéramos pausado, podría haber sido el lado equivocado)

examples.es: Si Alejandra no hubiera hablado, podríamos haber inyectado el lado derecho.
examples.en: If Alejandra hadn't spoken up, we could have injected the right side.

examples.es: Por poco seguimos la programación, que decía lado derecho.
examples.en: We almost followed the schedule, which said right side.

lessons.title: Contrast Reaction: Calling Rapid Response
lessons.objective: Stop the procedure, call for help with short clear commands, and keep the patient and team informed.

words.note: Singular in Spanish, plural in English.
Standard term in Mexico and US hospitals.
Often shortened to la vía.
Given only according to the hospital protocol and the physician's order.
Ustedes command to the whole team.
Informal: tú between coworkers.

words.en: I need rapid response in the interventional suite, now.
words.es: Necesito respuesta rápida en la sala de intervencionismo, ahora.

words.en: Before you give it, read me the dose from the protocol.
words.es: Antes de darlo, léeme la dosis según el protocolo.

words.en: If the pressure drops, we'll do what the protocol says.
words.es: Si la presión baja, haremos lo que indica el protocolo.

words.en: Ms. Montes, breathe slowly; you're not alone.
words.es: Señora Montes, respire despacio; no está sola.
words.note: Formal: usted with the patient.

words.en: If you feel worse, tell me and we'll act right away.
words.es: Si se siente peor, dígamelo y actuaremos enseguida.
words.note: Formal: usted with the patient.

words.en: When the team arrives, I'll give them the summary.
words.es: Cuando llegue el equipo, les daré el resumen.

lessons.speaking: You are the physician in the interventional suite at St. Clare's, and the AI is nurse Gerardo Aguilar: stop the procedure, call rapid response, give short commands like trae el carro rojo, and use si + present → future to explain next steps to Gerardo and Valeria Montes.

grammar.focus: Si + present → future; short radio or phone commands (si baja la presión, llamaremos; trae el carro)

examples.es: Si le cuesta más respirar, el equipo le pondrá oxígeno enseguida.
examples.en: If it gets harder to breathe, the team will give you oxygen right away.

examples.es: Trae el carro rojo y anota la hora de inicio.
examples.en: Bring the crash cart and write down the onset time.

lessons.title: Controlled-Substance Audit in the Procedure Suite
lessons.objective: Answer an auditor's formal questions on how controlled medications are stored, logged and wasted.

words.note: Address her as licenciada; it is written Lic. or Lcda. in Puerto Rico.
In Puerto Rico you will also hear la gaveta for a drawer.

words.en: Ms. Navarro, I'll gladly show you the logs.
words.es: Licenciada Navarro, con gusto le muestro los registros.
words.note: Formal: licenciada plus usted with the auditor.

words.en: According to our policy, the count is done at every shift change.
words.es: Según nuestra política, el conteo se hace en cada cambio de turno.

words.en: Only authorized staff have access to this cabinet.
words.es: Solo el personal autorizado tiene acceso a este gabinete.

words.en: You're right, that entry is missing the witness signature.
words.es: Tiene razón, a esa entrada le falta la firma del testigo.

words.en: The signature isn't added afterward without following the policy.
words.es: La firma no se agrega después sin seguir la política.

words.en: May I check with pharmacy before I answer?
words.es: ¿Me permite consultar con farmacia antes de responder?

words.en: Pharmacy will be notified today, according to institutional policy.
words.es: Se notificará a farmacia hoy mismo, según la política institucional.

words.en: Would you like me to send you a copy of the plan in writing?
words.es: ¿Desea que le envíe una copia del plan por escrito?

lessons.speaking: You are the CRNA at Hospital del Carmen, and the AI is auditor Lic. Patricia Navarro: answer her formal questions on how controlled medications are stored, logged and wasted, using usted and passive se (se guardan bajo llave, se documenta con testigo).

grammar.focus: Formal register; passive se for procedures (los medicamentos se guardan bajo llave, el desecho se documenta con testigo)

examples.es: Los medicamentos controlados se guardan bajo llave en el dispensador.
examples.en: Controlled medications are kept under lock and key in the dispensing cabinet.

examples.es: El desecho se documenta con testigo en el momento, no después.
examples.en: Waste is documented with a witness at the time, not afterward.

lessons.title: Dictating the Day's Report for the Director
lessons.objective: Dictate a clear written summary of the day: cases done, cases postponed, problems and tomorrow's plan.

words.note: Use la directora médica for a woman.
Used for the no-food rule before sedation.
Common in Mexico for open tasks or to-dos.

words.en: Today 9 of the 11 scheduled procedures were done.
words.es: Hoy se realizaron 9 de los 11 procedimientos programados.
words.note: Written register: impersonal se with past tense keeps the report neutral.

words.en: However, 2 cases were cancelled for different reasons.
words.es: Sin embargo, se cancelaron 2 casos por motivos distintos.

words.en: The first patient did not follow the fasting instructions for sedation.
words.es: El primer paciente no cumplió con el ayuno indicado para la sedación.

words.en: In addition, the C-arm failed at 2 in the afternoon.
words.es: Además, el arco en C falló a las 2 de la tarde.

words.en: Therefore, both cases were rescheduled for Thursday.
words.es: Por lo tanto, ambos casos se reprogramaron para el jueves.

words.en: Technical service will come first thing tomorrow.
words.es: El servicio técnico vendrá mañana a primera hora.

words.en: Dr. Ibarra, I'll email you the report before 6.
words.es: Doctor Ibarra, le envío el informe por correo antes de las 6.
words.note: Formal: usted with the director.

words.en: For tomorrow, I recommend confirming fasting one day ahead.
words.es: Para mañana, recomiendo confirmar el ayuno un día antes.

lessons.speaking: You are the pain physician dictating today's report, and the AI is Dr. Raúl Ibarra, the medical director: summarize the cases done, explain why two cases were cancelled, and give tomorrow's plan, linking ideas with además, sin embargo and por lo tanto.

grammar.focus: Written register; report connectors (además, sin embargo, por lo tanto)

examples.es: Además, se atendieron 4 consultas nuevas sin contratiempos.
examples.en: In addition, 4 new consultations were seen without setbacks.

examples.es: Sin embargo, el arco en C falló; por lo tanto, se canceló el último caso.
examples.en: However, the C-arm failed; therefore, the last case was cancelled.

lessons.title: Next-Day Callbacks After Injections
lessons.objective: Return patients' calls and texts politely, spot the one that needs escalation, and protect privacy.

words.note: Clinical word; patients usually say dolor de cabeza.
Many patients just say emergencias.

words.en: Good morning, I'm calling on behalf of the Sunvale Pain Clinic.
words.es: Buenos días, le llamo de parte de la Clínica del Dolor Sunvale.
words.note: Formal phone opening.

words.en: Could you confirm your full name and date of birth for me?
words.es: ¿Podría confirmarme su nombre completo y fecha de nacimiento?
words.note: Formal; verify identity before sharing anything.

words.en: Does the headache get worse when you stand up?
words.es: ¿El dolor de cabeza empeora cuando se levanta?

words.en: I'm going to notify the on-call doctor right now.
words.es: Voy a avisarle al médico de guardia ahora mismo.

words.en: If it gets worse before we call you, go to the emergency room.
words.es: Si empeora antes de que la llamemos, vaya a emergencias.

words.en: Diego, does Tuesday at 3 p.m. work for you?
words.es: Diego, ¿le queda bien el martes a las 3 p. m.?
words.note: Text message: keep it short, with no medical details.

words.en: Without your father's authorization, I can't give you information.
words.es: Sin la autorización de su papá, no puedo darle información.

words.en: Could you ask your father to call us directly?
words.es: ¿Podría pedirle a su papá que nos llame directamente?
words.note: Formal and polite to the daughter.

lessons.speaking: You are the clinician on the nurse line, and the AI plays patients and a family member who called or texted: return each message, verify identity, decide who needs the on-call doctor and protect privacy, using le llamo de parte de and ¿podría confirmarme...?

grammar.focus: Phone and text conventions; conditional politeness (¿podría confirmarme...?, le llamo de parte de)

examples.es: ¿Podría decirme a qué hora empezó el dolor?
examples.en: Could you tell me what time the pain started?

examples.es: Le llamo de parte del Dr. Rivas para darle seguimiento.
examples.en: I'm calling on behalf of Dr. Rivas to follow up with you.

lessons.title: End of the Stimulator Trial: Reviewing Results
lessons.objective: Review trial results with a patient and spouse and explain what would come next and under what conditions.

words.note: Use la cirujana for a woman.

words.en: I'm glad you had a better week.
words.es: Me da gusto que haya tenido una semana mejor.

words.en: According to your diary, the relief was about 60%.
words.es: Según su diario, el alivio fue de alrededor del 60%.

words.en: What activities could you do this week that you couldn't before?
words.es: ¿Qué actividades pudo hacer esta semana que antes no podía?

words.en: We would move to the permanent implant, as long as insurance approves it.
words.es: Pasaríamos al implante permanente, siempre que el seguro lo apruebe.

words.en: As long as the evaluation is complete, we could schedule the surgery.
words.es: Siempre que la evaluación esté completa, podríamos programar la cirugía.

words.en: Mr. Arturo, I understand the surgery worries you.
words.es: Don Arturo, entiendo que la cirugía le preocupe.
words.note: Don + first name is respectful and warm in Mexico.

words.en: If the relief didn't last, we could adjust the programming.
words.es: Si el alivio no durara, podríamos ajustar la programación.

words.en: If it doesn't work, the device can be removed.
words.es: En caso de que no funcione, el dispositivo se puede retirar.

lessons.speaking: You are the pain physician, and the AI is Rosa Elvira Maldonado with her husband Arturo: review her trial diary, explain the next steps and their conditions, and answer his concerns, using the conditional and siempre que + subjunctive.

grammar.focus: Conditional; subjunctive in conditions (siempre que el seguro lo apruebe, siempre que la evaluación esté completa)

examples.es: El cirujano la vería en 2 semanas, siempre que el seguro autorice la consulta.
examples.en: The surgeon would see you in 2 weeks, as long as insurance authorizes the visit.

examples.es: Usted seguiría con fisioterapia, siempre que el dolor lo permita.
examples.en: You would continue physical therapy, as long as the pain allows it.

lessons.title: Capstone: A Full Day Running the Procedure Suite
lessons.objective: Lead a full procedure day in Spanish: teach, adjust plans, handle an emergency, talk with patients and report.

words.note: Use el inspector estatal for a man.

words.en: Lucía, show them how to open the tray without contaminating it.
words.es: Lucía, enséñale a abrir la bandeja sin contaminarla.
words.note: Informal tú between coworkers.

words.en: Check the list before the first patient comes in.
words.es: Revisen la lista antes de que entre el primer paciente.
words.note: Ustedes command to the whole team.

words.en: Since you didn't stop the blood thinner, it isn't safe to inject today.
words.es: Como no suspendió el anticoagulante, hoy no es seguro inyectar.
words.note: Formal: usted with the patient.

words.en: We'll give you another appointment when your doctor approves stopping it.
words.es: Le daremos otra cita cuando su médico apruebe suspenderlo.

words.en: Lie down, sir; we're going to raise your legs.
words.es: Acuéstese, señor; le vamos a levantar las piernas.

words.en: I'll gladly show you this week's temperature log.
words.es: Con gusto le muestro el registro de temperatura de esta semana.
words.note: Formal with the surveyor.

words.en: How have you been since yesterday's injection?
words.es: ¿Cómo ha seguido desde la inyección de ayer?

words.en: In summary, 10 cases were done; however, 1 was postponed.
words.es: En resumen, se realizaron 10 casos; sin embargo, se pospuso 1.

lessons.speaking: You are the physician leading the procedure day, and the AI plays your team, patients, a state surveyor and the director: run the huddle, guide the trainer, talk with patients, answer the surveyor, return callbacks and dictate the report, using commands, subjunctive, conditionals and connectors.

grammar.focus: Capstone: integrating the Master 20 grammar

examples.es: Si la paciente hubiera suspendido el anticoagulante, la habríamos inyectado hoy.
examples.en: If the patient had stopped the blood thinner, we would have injected her today.

examples.es: Revisen que cada paciente haya suspendido su anticoagulante según la orden del médico.
examples.en: Check that each patient has stopped their blood thinner according to the doctor's order.
